keyDesignDecisionsFoundMidBuild.decision: EDGE_WORDS.side_corner wrapped in the existing requireString() helper (displayText: requireString(EDGE_WORDS.side_corner, "EDGE_WORDS.side_corner")) instead of the original bare `EDGE_WORDS.side_corner`.
keyDesignDecisionsFoundMidBuild.why: Not anticipated at CP1. hauska-atom-contract's tsconfig.json sets noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true (legacy-design-tools' does not, or at least vocabulary.ts's own build did not surface this), so EDGE_WORDS (typed Record<string,string>, a genuine index signature) returns string|undefined on any indexed access, and `npm run build` failed with TS2322 at this exact line. Confirmed no other indexed access in the file has the same problem: WIRE_DISPOSITION_DISPLAY_TEXT and STATE_WORDS are both typed over literal string-union keys, not generic string, so TypeScript treats those as plain properties, not index-signature reads, and noUncheckedIndexedAccess does not touch them. The fix reuses the module's own existing requireString() pattern (already used for ATOM_PATH_PENDING_DISPLAY_TEXT) rather than inventing a new one, and does not change the resulting displayText value, which is still "corner side" (confirmed at runtime, both locally and against the published package).
